meta.name: querying-well-data
meta.description: How to query a Well workspace correctly — discover the schema first, then query the right root. Use whenever the user asks about their invoices, companies, contacts, bank transactions, accounts, or accounting ledger in Well, or before writing any well_query_records call.

copy.tagline: 查询 Well 工作区中的发票、公司、联系人等数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你使用 Well 管理财务和业务数据，需要快速查询。
copy.tagline_en: Query invoices, companies, contacts, and more from Well workspace
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Well to manage financial and business data and need quick queries.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在回答关于 Well 工作区的财务数据前，会先调用 well_get_schema 获取数据结构，再使用 well_query_records 精准查询，避免猜字段名。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Well 中的发票、公司、联系人、银行交易、账户或会计分类账时触发；也用于编写 well_query_records 调用之前。

say.note: Claude 会先获取发票的 schema，然后查询记录。

say.text: 帮我看看有哪些客户公司

howto.what_en: After installation, before answering financial data about a Well workspace, Claude first calls well_get_schema to discover the data structure, then uses well_query_records to query precisely, avoiding guessing field names.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about invoices, companies, contacts, bank transactions, accounts, or accounting ledger in Well; also before writing a well_query_records call.

say_en.note: Claude will get the invoice schema first, then query records.
Claude will get the company root schema first, then return company info.
Claude will check the ledger-related schema first, then execute the query.
